This chapter is about working: the verb **to work** (اشتغل — eshta8al), the jobs you do, and the places you do them. Tap any sentence to reveal its franco and English.

## How it works

اشتغل is a regular verb. The two things you'll say most are *what* you do and *where* you do it, and they use two simple patterns:

| Pattern | Example | Meaning |
|----|----|----|
| بشتغل + profession | بشتغل دكتور — bashta8al doktor | I work as a doctor |
| بشتغل في + place | بشتغل في مستشفى — bashta8al fi mostashfa | I work in a hospital |
| بشتغل من + place | بشتغل من البيت — bashta8al men el-bet | I work from home |

Notice there's no word for "as" — the profession goes straight after the verb. To ask, use **بتشتغل إيه؟ (bitishta8al eh?)** "what do you do?" and **بتشتغل فين؟ (bitishta8al feen?)** "where do you work?".

## To work — اشتغل — eshta8al

Regular verb. Future: ها + stem (*ana hashta8al*); past: *ana eshta8alt, huwwa eshta8al*.

| Pronoun     | Present                 |
|-------------|-------------------------|
| أنا - ana   | بشتغل - bashta8al       |
| إنت - inta  | بتشتغل - bitishta8al    |
| إنتِ - inti  | بتشتغلي - bitishta8ali  |
| هو - huwwa  | بيشتغل - biyishta8al    |
| هي - hiyya  | بتشتغل - bitishta8al    |
| إحنا - e7na | بنشتغل - binishta8al    |
| إنتو - intu | بتشتغلوا - bitishta8alu |
| هم - humma  | بيشتغلوا - biyishta8alu |

## Professions

The masculine and feminine forms side by side — the feminine almost always just adds **ة (‑a)**.

| Masculine - franco | Feminine - franco  | English          |
|--------------------|--------------------|------------------|
| دكتور - doktor     | دكتورة - doktora   | doctor           |
| مدرس - modarres    | مدرسة - modarresa  | teacher          |
| مهندس - mohandes   | مهندسة - mohandesa | engineer         |
| محامي - mo7ami     | محامية - mo7ameya  | lawyer           |
| ممرض - momarred    | ممرضة - momarreda  | nurse            |
| طباخ - tabba5      | طباخة - tabba5a    | cook / chef      |
| سواق - sawwa2      | سواقة - sawwa2a    | driver           |
| موظف - mowazzaf    | موظفة - mowazzafa  | employee / clerk |
| باحث - ba7es       | باحثة - ba7esa     | researcher       |
| صحفي - so7ofi      | صحفية - so7ofeya   | journalist       |

## Places of work

| Arabic - franco    | English    |
|--------------------|------------|
| مستشفى - mostashfa | hospital   |
| مدرسة - madrasa    | school     |
| جامعة - gam3a      | university |
| مكتب - maktab      | office     |
| شركة - sherka      | company    |
| مطعم - mat3am      | restaurant |
| بنك - bank         | bank       |
| مصنع - masna3      | factory    |
| محل - ma7all       | shop       |
| البيت - el-bet     | home       |

<details class="frase">

<summary>أنا بشتغل دكتور</summary>

</details>

<details class="frase">

</details>

<details class="frase">

<summary>هي بتشتغل مدرسة في مدرسة</summary>

</details>

<details class="frase">

<summary>بشتغل من البيت</summary>

[bashta8al men el-bet]{.fr} [I work from home]{.en}

</details>

## Dialogue: "What do you do?"

Amr and Dalia compare jobs.

[عمرو — Amr]{.rotulo}

<details class="frase">

<summary>بتشتغلي إيه؟</summary>

[bitishta8ali eh?]{.fr} [What do you do?]{.en}

</details>

[داليا — Dalia]{.rotulo}

<details class="frase">

<summary>بشتغل دكتورة في مستشفى</summary>

[bashta8al doktora fi mostashfa]{.fr} [I work as a doctor in a hospital]{.en}

</details>

[عمرو — Amr]{.rotulo}

<details class="frase">

<summary>بتشتغلي فين بالظبط؟</summary>

[bitishta8ali feen bel-zabt?]{.fr} [Where exactly do you work?]{.en}

</details>

[داليا — Dalia]{.rotulo}

<details class="frase">

<summary>في مستشفى كبير في القاهرة. وإنت؟</summary>

[fi mostashfa kbeer fi el-2ahira. wenta?]{.fr} [In a big hospital in Cairo. And you?]{.en}

</details>

[عمرو — Amr]{.rotulo}

<details class="frase">

<summary>أنا مهندس، بشتغل في شركة</summary>

[ana mohandes, bashta8al fi sherka]{.fr} [I'm an engineer, I work at a company]{.en}

</details>
